name: Krishanveer Forge Ltd.
summary: Krishanveer Forge Ltd. primarily manufactures essential forged components and specialized parts. These products are supplied to a broad spectrum of fundamental industries, including oil, gas, power generation, iron, steel, sugar, cement, chemical, and fertilizer production, as well as general engineering and other related core sectors. Furthermore, the company offers services in marketing, web development, and mobile application design. Established on June 22, 1990, the firm maintains its headquarters in Pune, India.
